issue.title: URL dedupe keys and display URLs drop explicit non-default ports (dead port_or_known_default comparison)

task_type_fields.impact: Two different sources on the same host and path but different ports (for example a self-hosted service on :8443 and the site on :443) are treated as the same reference. A clip or import of the second is deduplicated against the first: it is either refused as a duplicate or matched to the wrong reference note. The same bug drops the port from display URLs.
task_type_fields.repro:
`dedupe_key_for` (src/native/highlights_ref/clip_url.rs:90-93) appends `:{port}` only when `Some(port) != url.port_or_known_default()`. The url crate's `port()` already returns `None` for a scheme-default port, and `port_or_known_default()` returns the explicit port whenever one is set, so the condition is never true: every explicit non-default port is dropped from the dedupe key. `display_url` in src/native/url_routing/intent.rs:118-122 has the same dead comparison, so display text also drops the port.

Reproduction (url = "2", the crate bob uses), probe run 2026-10-25 by the batch-9 lander:

    https://example.com:8443/a: port()=Some(8443) port_or_known_default()=Some(8443) kept_in_key=false
    https://example.com:443/a:  port()=None       port_or_known_default()=Some(443)  kept_in_key=false
    https://example.com/a:      port()=None       port_or_known_default()=Some(443)  kept_in_key=false

So `https://example.com:8443/a` and `https://example.com/a` produce the same dedupe key. docs/highlights-clip.md (around line 140) promises only that the *default* port is dropped.

Likely fix: keep `if let Some(port) = url.port()` (the url crate already strips default ports) in both places, add unit tests for a non-default port, a spelled-out default port, and no port, and check whether any stored dedupe keys or existing reference notes depend on the current key shape before changing it.

Provenance: first reported, unfixed, in the body of bob-cli commit 1194779f ("docs: clarify reference URL identity and Medium aliases", agent chop.refresh_docs.bob-cli.2). The batch-9 lander (bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.land) independently reproduced it while reviewing post-start drift.

issue.creation_reason: The batch-9 lander found this unfixed source follow-up in post-start drift commit 1194779f and reproduced it; nothing tracked it, and it can merge distinct references.

payload.description: Closed sibling URL-identity defect in the same dedupe_key_for (percent-escape/%40 handling); the port fix must keep its tests green
